info.title: Azure Retail Prices
info.description: Every published Azure meter and its list price. No key and no sign-up, which makes it the worked example for costing: ask it what a SKU lists at, and ask the vault what your own agreement says about the same one.

get.summary: List prices, narrowed by an OData filter over service, region, SKU and meter
get.description: `filter` is OData over the fields each item carries: `serviceName`, `armRegionName`, `armSkuName`, `meterName`, `productName`, `priceType`. One page is 100 items; `skip` walks the rest.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: an OData filter, for example: serviceName eq 'Virtual Machines' and armRegionName eq 'westeurope' and armSkuName eq 'Standard_D4s_v5'

parameters.name: currencyCode
parameters.description: the currency prices are quoted in; USD when omitted

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: items to skip, in hundreds: the page size is fixed at 100

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: the price schema to answer with

200.description: one page of meters and their list prices
